results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: An article detailing a major study by Fabio Giglietto investigating how Meta's recommendation algorithms dramatically reduced the visibility of mainstream Italian politicians (by 72%) on Facebook while inadvertently highlighting extremist accounts. Giglietto is quoted explaining the asymmetric impact of these content reduction policies and highlighting the value of transparency tools mandated by the Digital Services Act.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
results.snippet: An institutional news release detailing the public debate triggered by Fabio Giglietto's study on Meta's algorithmic policies. It highlights how his findings on Facebook visibility limitations for Italian parliamentarians led to a formal inquiry in the European Parliament and national media coverage.
